preregistered_analysis.F_formation: L_f = smallest L in 7..11 with S(resid, L) >= 1/2 * S(resid, 11) and SPEC(resid, L); reported with the full profile
preregistered_analysis.S: S(comp, L) = #cells where the main-source patch is JOINT and the ROUND-source patch (same comp, L) is not; resid at L11 is taken from the pinned M1 raw (main and round arms)
preregistered_analysis.SPEC: SPEC(comp, L) iff dM_main > dM_round in >= 75% of cells AND in a majority of cells for >= 10 of 14 donor groups
preregistered_analysis.W_writer: at each L in 8..11, component X in {mixer, mlp} is a SUFFICIENT_WRITER iff S(X, L) >= 1/2 * S(resid, L) and SPEC(X, L)
preregistered_analysis.always_reported: S and median dM per (comp, L, source); leave-one-donor-group-out of the verdict; per host; all nulls
preregistered_analysis.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: MIXER_WRITER: the evaluation enters the span through token mixing (context -> span) at L_ref; the failing host's deficit is in what its mixer brings into the span. MLP_WRITER: the donor's span MLP output at L_ref carries the evaluation; the deficit is in the span's own nonlinear computation (or its inputs). Sufficiency of a sublayer patch does not show necessity; no ablation is run
preregistered_analysis.readouts: M = conflict margin; A = logit(reject_conflict) - max(accept, wait); JOINT = M > 0 and A > 0; dM = M(patch) - M(in-run host capture)
preregistered_analysis.units: the 104 cross-group cells; source groups are the unit; cells share donors and hosts, counts are descriptive decision rules, not independent tests
preregistered_analysis.verdict: at L_ref = max(L_f, 8): MIXER_WRITER if only mixer is a sufficient writer; MLP_WRITER if only mlp; BOTH_SUFFICIENT if both; NEITHER_ALONE if neither (consistent with an evaluation spread over both sublayers or an interaction); the per-layer writer table is always reported
